source: NOAA National Data Buoy Center latest observations feed (all reporting buoys/C-MAN stations worldwide, one row per station)
license: US government public domain (noaa.gov/information-technology/open-data-policy) — no key, single global file, no documented rate limit, commercial-lawful with attribution

field_map.station: NDBC station id (buoy or C-MAN) — used as the archive dedup key alongside observation time
field_map.time: observation time, ms epoch UTC — a later archive row for the same station with a newer time supersedes the prior one
field_map.tide: water level relative to MLLW, ft

confidence_model: RAW overlay — NDBC-reported values carried verbatim; a station's 'MM' (missing) sensor reading is kept as null, never coerced to 0. No predictive claim; a future marine-hazard or shipping-exposure SIGNAL is separate, unattempted gate-1/gate-2 work.
cadence: 30-min poll; individual stations typically report hourly, dedup keyed on (station, observation time) makes over-polling a cheap no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
